name: Kibler's Exotic Pets

faq.answer: Kibler is a collector seeking ferocious beasts, including young worgs from Blackrock Spire.
Bloodaxe worg pups prowl inside Blackrock Spire alongside the Bloodaxe orcs.
faq.q: Where are the worg pups found?

faq.answer: Kibler provides a sturdy cage built to hold the fierce beasts securely for transport.
faq.q: How do you capture a worg pup?

faq.answer: Even as pups, the Bloodaxe beasts are ferocious and ready to bite.

sections.body: Kibler has an eye for dangerous beasts and wants a prize from Blackrock Spire. The Bloodaxe worgs breed within the dark halls of the mountain fortress, fierce from the moment they are whelped. You carry a cage into the spire to trap one of the ferocious pups alive and bring it out.
sections.title: Beasts of Blackrock

summary: Kibler seeks a live specimen from the dark halls of Blackrock Spire. To satisfy him, you must venture into the mountain fortress and trap a ferocious Bloodaxe worg pup in a sturdy cage.
